title: Standard plan: features, allowances and fees
text: Standard is Quaymark Money's free current account plan, with no monthly fee and no minimum term. It includes a contactless Mastercard debit card, instant spending notifications, savings pots and access to the Easy Access Saver. Spending abroad: card payments in foreign currencies are fee-free up to £1,000 per calendar month; above that, a 1% fee applies to the amount converted. Cash withdrawals: the first £250 of cash withdrawals in any rolling 30 days is fee-free, at home or abroad; after that a 2% fee applies to the amount above £250. This applies at all cash machines, including free-to-use machines in the UK, and is in addition to any fee the machine's operator charges. Daily cash withdrawal limit: £500. Card replacement: a replacement for a lost or stolen card costs £5. Replacements for damaged, faulty or expiring cards are free. Virtual cards: one virtual card for online shopping. Support: in-app chat 24 hours a day in the standard queue. Upgrading: you can move to Plus at any time in the app, and the change takes effect immediately; the Plus minimum term starts on the day you upgrade. Downgrading from Plus back to Standard is possible once the Plus minimum term has ended.

title: Plus plan: price, minimum term, allowances and fees
text: Plus is Quaymark Money's paid plan. It costs £4.99 a month, charged on the same date each month, and has a 6-month minimum term. You can cancel during the minimum term, but the remaining monthly fees up to the end of the 6 months are charged in one go when you cancel. After the first 6 months, Plus rolls monthly and can be cancelled at any time with no further charge. Spending abroad: card payments in foreign currencies are fee-free with no monthly cap. Cash withdrawals: the first £600 of cash withdrawals in any rolling 30 days is fee-free, at home or abroad; after that a 2% fee applies to the amount above £600. This applies at all cash machines and is in addition to any fee the machine's operator charges. Daily cash withdrawal limit: £800. Card replacement: one lost or stolen replacement every 12 months is free, then £5 each. Replacements for damaged, faulty or expiring cards are free. Virtual cards: up to 5 virtual cards for online shopping. Support: in-app chat 24 hours a day in a priority queue. Plus includes everything in Standard. The Easy Access Saver rate is the same on both plans.

title: Using your card abroad: exchange rates, fees and tips
text: Your Quaymark Money card works anywhere Mastercard is accepted, in over 200 countries and territories. You don't need to tell us before you travel; our fraud systems use your phone's location to recognise genuine spending abroad, so keep location services switched on for the app. Exchange rates: foreign currency payments and withdrawals are converted at the Mastercard exchange rate on the day the payment is processed, with no added markup on weekdays or weekends. Fees depend on your plan. On Standard, card payments abroad are fee-free up to £1,000 per calendar month, then a 1% fee applies. On Plus there is no monthly cap. Cash withdrawals abroad count towards the same fee-free cash allowance as UK withdrawals, £250 per rolling 30 days on Standard and £600 on Plus, with 2% charged above that. Some foreign cash machines add their own fee, which we can't refund. If a machine or shop asks whether to pay in pounds or the local currency, always choose the local currency; otherwise the merchant converts the amount at its own rate. Hotel and car hire deposits abroad show as pending holds and are released as described on the pending transactions page. If your card is declined abroad, check that the card isn't frozen, that you haven't reached your daily limit and that the merchant accepts Mastercard, then contact us in the app.

title: Lost, stolen and damaged cards: replacement fees and delivery
text: If your card is lost or stolen, report it in the app under Card, Report lost or stolen. Reporting cancels the card permanently, so it can't be reactivated even if you find it later. If you think you've simply misplaced it, freeze the card instead; freezing is temporary and you can unfreeze it at any time. Replacement fees: on Standard, a replacement for a lost or stolen card costs £5. On Plus, one lost or stolen replacement every 12 months is free, then £5 each. Replacements for damaged, faulty or expiring cards are always free. Delivery: standard delivery takes 3 to 5 working days and is free. Express delivery arrives the next working day for £12 if you order before 4 pm, Monday to Friday; orders after 4 pm or at weekends arrive on the second working day. Express delivery is available to UK addresses only, and we can't send replacement cards abroad. Replacement cards for lost or stolen cards have a new card number, expiry date and security code, so update any subscriptions and saved card details. Your PIN stays the same. While you wait, the new card's details are available in the app as soon as it's ordered, so you can add it to your phone wallet and keep paying.

title: Disputing a card payment, effective 1 June 2023
text: Disputing a card payment, effective 1 June 2023. If you have a problem with a card payment, for example goods that never arrived, a cancelled service you were still charged for, or a payment taken twice, first contact the merchant and give them 14 days to resolve it. If they don't, raise a dispute in the app by opening the transaction and choosing Something's wrong. You must raise a dispute within 120 days of the transaction date. Upload evidence such as receipts, emails and tracking information. We will review the dispute and, where appropriate, raise a chargeback with Mastercard. Temporary credits are not given while a dispute is reviewed. A final decision is usually made within 60 days, but some cases can take longer if the merchant challenges the chargeback. If the dispute succeeds, the money is credited to your account. If it fails, we'll explain why. Unauthorised payments that you didn't make yourself are handled separately as fraud and should be reported immediately; you can report these up to 13 months after the payment.

title: Disputing a card payment, effective 1 March 2026 (replaces the June 2023 version)
text: Disputing a card payment, effective 1 March 2026. This replaces the version effective 1 June 2023. If you have a problem with a card payment, such as goods that never arrived, a cancelled subscription that was still charged, or a duplicate payment, contact the merchant first. If they don't resolve it within 14 days, raise a dispute in the app by opening the transaction and choosing Something's wrong. You must raise a dispute within 30 days from the transaction date; disputes raised later are not accepted. This window is shorter than the previous 120 days, so raise disputes as soon as you notice a problem. Upload evidence such as receipts, emails and tracking details. Temporary credit: if your evidence supports the dispute, we give a temporary credit for the disputed amount within 10 working days while the chargeback is processed. A final decision is made within 45 days. If the merchant successfully defends the chargeback, the temporary credit is reversed and we'll explain why, giving you 7 days' notice before the money is taken back. If the dispute succeeds, the temporary credit becomes permanent. Unauthorised payments you didn't make yourself are handled as fraud, not disputes, and the 30-day window does not apply to them; report them immediately.

title: Bank transfers: limits, new payees and international payments
text: Bank transfers from Quaymark Money are sent by Faster Payments. Limits: a single payment can be up to £10,000, and you can send up to £25,000 per day in total. New payees: when you add a new payee, Confirmation of Payee checks the name against the receiving account. The first payment over £1,000 to a new payee is held for up to 24 hours for fraud checks before it is sent; we may contact you in the app during this time. Payments of £1,000 or less to new payees, and all payments to existing payees, are normally sent immediately and usually arrive within 2 hours. You can't cancel a payment once it has been sent. Standing orders and scheduled payments are sent on the morning of the due date. Direct Debits are collected under the Direct Debit Guarantee. International transfers: sent through our transfer partner in over 40 currencies at the mid-market rate plus a fee of 0.45%, minimum £1.50. They usually arrive within 1 to 2 working days. Receiving money: your sort code and account number are in the app under Account details. To receive international payments, use your IBAN. Incoming international payments cost £2 per payment.

title: Pending card payments, holds and refunds
text: When you pay by card, the merchant first requests an authorisation, and the amount shows as pending and is held from your available balance. The payment normally completes within 1 to 3 days when the merchant collects it. If the merchant never collects the payment, the hold is released automatically. How long holds last: most holds drop off after 7 days. Hotel, car hire and cruise holds can last up to 31 days, because these merchants are allowed to collect later. Pay-at-pump fuel payments may hold up to £99, and the difference is released once the final amount is confirmed, usually within 2 working days. We can't release a hold early ourselves, because the merchant still has the right to collect it. If a merchant confirms in writing that they've cancelled the authorisation, send it to us in the app and we will release the hold within 1 working day. Refunds: when a merchant issues a refund to your card, it usually appears within 5 working days, although some merchants take longer to send it. A refund appears as a separate credit, not as a change to the original payment. If a pending payment disappears and later reappears as completed, the merchant collected the payment after the hold expired, which is allowed.

title: Easy Access Saver and 1-Year Fixed Saver
text: Easy Access Saver: 3.10% AER variable on balances up to £250,000. Interest is calculated daily and paid monthly into the Saver. You can open it in the app with any amount from £1. Withdrawals: you can move money back to your current account instantly, but only 3 withdrawals per calendar year keep the full rate. From the 4th withdrawal in a calendar year, the rate drops to 1.00% AER for the rest of that calendar year, on the whole balance. The count resets on 1 January. Paying in has no limit. 1-Year Fixed Saver: 4.05% AER fixed, minimum deposit £500, maximum £250,000. You have 14 days after opening to add money or cancel; after that, no withdrawals or closures are possible until maturity. Interest on the Fixed Saver is paid at maturity, and the money then moves to your Easy Access Saver unless you choose another option. Savings pots inside your current account don't earn interest; they're for setting money aside. The Easy Access Saver rate is the same on Standard and Plus. We'll give you 14 days' notice before reducing the Easy Access Saver rate. Interest is paid without tax deducted; you may need to pay tax if your interest is more than your Personal Savings Allowance.

title: Overdrafts and going below zero
text: Quaymark Money does not offer unarranged overdrafts. If a payment would take your balance below zero and you don't have an arranged overdraft, we will normally decline it, and we don't charge any fee for declined payments. Occasionally a balance can still go below zero, for example when a merchant collects an offline card payment or an exchange rate moves between authorisation and settlement. In that case no fee or interest is charged, and you should add money as soon as possible. If the balance stays negative for 30 days, we may close the account. Arranged overdraft: you can apply in the app for an arranged overdraft of £50 to £2,000, subject to a credit check. The first £25 of overdraft use is interest-free. Above that, interest is charged at 29.9% EAR variable on the amount overdrawn, calculated daily and charged monthly. Representative example: if you use an overdraft of £1,200, the interest rate is 29.9% EAR variable. There are no monthly or daily overdraft fees. Applying runs a hard credit search, which shows on your credit file. You can reduce or remove your overdraft limit at any time in the app.

title: Identity checks when opening an account and reverification
text: To open a Quaymark Money account, you need to be 18 or over, live in the UK and have a UK mobile number. We verify your identity with a photo of your passport, UK driving licence or biometric residence permit, and a short selfie video that we match to the photo. Verification usually takes under 10 minutes but can take up to 2 working days if we need a manual review. Ongoing checks: we're required to keep your information up to date, so we ask some customers to reverify, for example when an ID document expires, when your details change, or as part of a routine review every 3 years. When we ask, you have 30 days from the request to complete reverification in the app. If you don't, card payments and outgoing transfers are paused until it's done; incoming payments are still accepted. If it's still not done after 60 days, we may close the account with 2 months' notice. Change of name or address: update it in the app; a change of name needs a photo of the new ID or of the marriage certificate or deed poll. We never ask you to verify your identity through an email link or a phone call; reverification only happens inside the app.

title: Reporting fraud and recognising scams
text: If you spot a payment you don't recognise, freeze your card in the app straight away and tell us through in-app chat or by calling our 24-hour fraud line on 0808 157 0436, or +44 20 7946 0436 from abroad. The fraud line is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including bank holidays. Unauthorised card payments are refunded by the end of the next working day after you report them, unless we have reasonable grounds to suspect fraud by the customer. If you were tricked into sending money to a fraudster, report it as soon as possible; you can report these scams up to 13 months after the last payment. Things we will never do: ask you to move money to a safe account, ask for your PIN or full passcode, ask you to read out a code we've sent you, or ask you to install remote access software. Anyone who does is a fraudster. Hang up and contact us using the details in the app. If you want to check whether a call really came from us, open the app: any genuine call from us shows in the app while it's happening. Card payments and transfers can be blocked for gambling, crypto exchanges or all online payments in the app's card settings.

title: Contacting us: chat, phone hours, complaints and cash
text: In-app chat is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, for all customers; Plus customers are placed in a priority queue. Phone support on 0808 157 0400 is open 8 am to 8 pm Monday to Friday and 9 am to 5 pm on Saturdays; the phone line is closed on Sundays and bank holidays, except for the 24-hour fraud line. Calls from abroad: +44 20 7946 0400, charged at your provider's international rate. We don't have branches. You can pay cash into your account at any Post Office using your card, up to £1,000 per day, with a fee of £1 per deposit. Cheques can be paid in by taking a photo in the app, up to £1,000 per cheque. Complaints: raise a complaint in the app or by phone. We send a final response within 15 business days for payment-related complaints, or within 8 weeks for other complaints. If you're unhappy with our final response, you can refer it to the Financial Ombudsman Service free of charge. Accessibility: we offer a text relay service, large-print statements and a bereavement team on 0808 157 0411.

title: Closing your account
text: You can close your Quaymark Money account in the app under Settings, Close account, or by asking in chat. Before closing, your balance must be zero or above, any arranged overdraft must be repaid, Easy Access Saver money must be moved out, and any Fixed Saver must have matured. Outstanding Plus fees for the minimum term are charged at closure. Pending card payments must settle first, so closure completes 7 days after your request; your card stops working immediately. Any remaining balance is sent to a UK account in your name within 2 working days. Direct Debits and standing orders are cancelled, so let the companies you pay know your new details. Statements are available in the app until closure, and you can request statements for up to 6 years after closing by asking in chat or by email. Accounts with no activity for 24 months are marked inactive but not closed; we'll give you 2 months' notice before closing an inactive account. If you change your mind within 14 days of opening, you can cancel and close without any charges.
